verdict.rationale: The public pages state up front that SOSPortal uses multi-factor authentication, accept ACH and credit card, and point to a Business Filings Guide and how-to videos, so some pre-flow disclosure of account and credential steps exists. The evidence does not show an explicit, exhaustive list of the gating steps before filing begins. missing for 10: an explicit published list of account-creation and credential steps, any statement on whether identity proofing is required, evidence of what the Business Filings Guide actually covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that nothing further surfaces mid-flow.
